get.description: Every COMPLETED review for this employee across every cycle, each with its own cycle record included, newest completion first.

post.summary: Create a training course
post.description: Rejected if the code is already used by another course in the same entity (entityId+code is unique).

get.summary: List training courses
get.description: Active courses only, optionally filtered by entityId.

post.summary: Schedule a training session
post.description: The course must already exist. Rejected if endDate is before startDate.

get.summary: List training sessions
get.description: Optionally filtered by courseId/status, ordered by start date ascending.

get.summary: Training calendar for a date range
get.description: Sessions whose own date range overlaps [from, to] at all (not sessions starting within the window only) — a session that starts before `from` but ends after it is still included.

post.summary: Enrol an employee in a training session
post.description: Rejected if the session is CANCELLED, or if this employee is already enrolled in it (sessionId+employeeId is unique).

post.summary: Mark an enrollment as attended
Cancel an enrollment
Record a post-training evaluation for an enrollment
post.description: Only callable once the enrollment is marked ATTENDED. evaluationRating must be between 1 and 5. Does NOT issue a certificate as a side effect — certification is always its own separate call.

get.summary: List training enrollments
get.description: Optionally filtered by employeeId/sessionId. Includes each session's own course and any linked certification.

post.summary: Issue a certification
post.description: If linked to a trainingEnrollmentId, rejected when that enrollment already has a certification (one certification per enrollment). Can also be issued standalone, with no linked enrollment at all.

get.summary: List an employee's certifications
get.description: Newest issue date first.

get.summary: List certifications expiring soon
get.description: Certifications whose expiryDate falls between now and daysAhead days from now (default 30) — feeds renewal reminders. Already-expired certifications are not included.

get.summary: Skills matrix: active employees vs their held certifications
get.description: Derived on the fly from Certification records, not a separately-stored skills matrix — every active employee in the entity, each with a list of their own certification names and expiry dates.

post.summary: Create a succession plan for a position

get.summary: List succession plans
get.description: entityId and criticality are both optional filters.

post.summary: Add a candidate to a succession plan
post.description: Rejected with a 409 if this employee is already mapped as a candidate for this plan.

post.summary: Update a candidate's readiness rating and development notes

get.summary: List every candidate flagged as high-potential, across every succession plan
List HIGH/CRITICAL-criticality plans with no candidate yet rated READY_NOW
get.description: The leadership-risk view: a plan appears here only if its criticality is HIGH or CRITICAL AND none of its candidates has readiness=READY_NOW yet.

get.summary: Get my own employee profile

post.summary: Update my own profile
post.description: Deliberately narrow: only phone, personalEmail, and residentialAddress can be self-edited here. jobTitle, gradeLevel, salary, department, and employmentStatus all stay HR/manager-only, via the employee-lifecycle and employment-event routes instead.

get.summary: List my own payslips
get.description: Newest first.

get.summary: List my own attendance records
get.description: Optional from/to date filter.

get.summary: Get my own leave balances

get.summary: List my own leave requests
List my own performance review history
get.description: Includes each review's own cycle. Newest first.

get.summary: List my own goals
List my own training enrollments

post.summary: Enrol myself in a training session
post.description: Delegates to the same TrainingService.enrol every other enrolment path uses — rejected if the session is CANCELLED, or if I am already enrolled in it.

get.summary: List my own certifications

post.summary: Upload a document to my own employee record

get.summary: Get headcount broken down by department, employment type, and gender
get.description: Active employees only.

get.summary: Get the annualized turnover rate for a date range
get.description: turnoverRatePercent = exits in range / average of headcount at the start and end of the range, as a percentage. Exits are counted by lastWorkingDate falling within [from, to].

get.summary: Get leave entitlement vs. usage by leave type for a given year
Get present/late/absent rates for a date range
Get job application counts by stage, and the overall hire rate
get.description: from and to are both optional — omitting either includes every application regardless of date.

get.summary: Get current monthly payroll cost by department
get.description: Active, non-terminated employees only, using each employee's own currently-assigned salary structure — not a historical payslip total from any specific payroll run.

get.summary: Get the overall training completion rate
get.description: completionRatePercent = enrollments with status=ATTENDED / all enrollments, across every course and session.

get.summary: Get a single bundled HR executive dashboard
get.description: Combines headcount, turnover, attendance, hiring funnel, payroll cost, and training completion in one call — turnover/attendance/hiring-funnel are computed for the current calendar year to date. leaveUtilization is not included (it needs an explicit year the summary does not ask for) — call GET leave-utilization separately for that figure.

post.summary: Create a job requisition
post.description: Starts as DRAFT. entityId must be within the caller's own postable RLS scope.

get.summary: List job requisitions
get.description: Scoped to the caller's own RLS-viewable entities/departments/cost centers/projects/business units; optionally filtered by entityId/status.

get.summary: Get a job requisition
get.description: Returns 404, not 403, if the requisition exists but is outside the caller's own RLS scope.

post.summary: Submit a DRAFT requisition for approval
post.description: Only callable while the requisition is DRAFT. Starts a RECRUITMENT_REQUISITION workflow instance and moves the requisition to PENDING_APPROVAL.

post.summary: Reconcile a requisition's status with its approval workflow instance
post.description: Call after acting on the underlying workflow instance. Moves the requisition to APPROVED or REJECTED once the workflow instance itself resolves; otherwise returns it unchanged.

post.summary: Close a job requisition
post.description: Callable at any status except CLOSED, including abandoning a requisition that was never submitted — unlike closing a vacancy, there is no status restriction here.

post.summary: Open a vacancy against an approved requisition
post.description: The referenced requisition must be APPROVED. Starts as DRAFT; employmentType/departmentId default to the requisition's own values when not supplied.

get.summary: List vacancies
get.description: Includes each vacancy's own application count. Optionally filtered by entityId/status.

get.summary: Get a vacancy
get.description: Includes every application against it, each with its own candidate.

patch.description: Only callable from DRAFT or ON_HOLD. Moves it to OPEN, accepting applications.
Set filled=true to record it as FILLED, or omit/false for CLOSED (unfilled) — two distinct outcomes, not a single close with a follow-up choice.

get.summary: Recruiter dashboard
get.description: Open vacancies, pending requisitions, the applications pipeline by stage, upcoming interviews, and calendar/Teams sync-failure counts (contact/signature sync failures are tracked in their own list endpoints, not counted here).

get.summary: Per-vacancy pipeline report
get.description: One row per vacancy: total/hired/rejected application counts and average time-to-hire in days (null if nobody has been hired for it yet).

post.summary: Create or update a candidate profile
post.description: Upsert keyed by email, not id. A brand-new candidate gets a best-effort Outlook contact created; an existing candidate whose contact already synced gets that contact updated instead — both failures set contactSyncFailedAt rather than blocking the profile write.

get.summary: List candidates
get.description: Optionally filtered by a partial, case-sensitive email match.

get.summary: List candidates with a failed Outlook contact sync
get.description: Every candidate whose contactSyncFailedAt is set, newest failure first — the source list behind the recruitment "needs attention" widget's contact-sync half. A candidate with no applications yet can still appear here.

get.summary: Get a candidate profile
get.description: Includes documents and every application (each with its own vacancy, interviews, and offer).

post.summary: Retry a failed Outlook contact sync
post.description: Rejected if there is no failed sync to retry. If the original create never succeeded, retries the create; if a later edit failed to sync against an existing contact, retries the update against that same contact instead of creating a duplicate.

post.summary: Retry a failed Google Workspace directory-account sync for a hired employee
post.description: Rejected if there is no failed sync to retry, or if a directory user already exists (no update/suspend retry path exists yet — only the original create can be retried).

post.summary: Attach a document to a candidate
post.description: E.g. a resume/CV. The candidate must already exist.

get.summary: List a candidate's documents

post.summary: Apply a candidate to a vacancy
post.description: Rejected if the vacancy is not OPEN, or if this candidate has already applied to it. Starts at the APPLIED stage.

get.summary: Get an application
get.description: Includes candidate, vacancy, every interview (with its own feedback), offer, and background check.

get.summary: List applications for a vacancy
get.description: Optionally filtered by pipeline stage.

patch.summary: Move an application to a different pipeline stage
patch.description: The pipeline is forward-only (APPLIED -> SCREENING -> SHORTLISTED -> INTERVIEW -> OFFER -> HIRED); moving backward, or moving an application that is already in a terminal stage, is rejected. REJECTED/WITHDRAWN are reachable from any non-terminal stage. HIRED cannot be set here at all — use the hire endpoint, which also provisions the employee record.
Must be between 0 and 100. Independent of pipeline stage.

post.summary: Hire a candidate, provisioning an Employee record
post.description: Requires the application to be at the OFFER stage with an ACCEPTED offer, and — if a background check exists for it — that check must be CLEARED. Creates the Employee row and moves the application to HIRED in one transaction, then best-effort creates a Google Workspace directory account (failure sets directorySyncFailedAt rather than losing the new Employee record).

get.summary: Browse open vacancies
get.description: Lists vacancies with status OPEN, optionally filtered to one entityId, each with its own current applicant count.

post.summary: Create or update a candidate profile
post.description: Upserts by email — submitting the same email again updates the existing profile rather than creating a duplicate.

get.summary: Get a candidate's own profile
get.description: Returns the candidate with their documents and every application (each including its own vacancy, interviews, and offer).

post.summary: Attach a document (e.g. resume) to a candidate profile
post.description: The candidate must already exist — attaching to an unknown candidateId is rejected rather than silently ignored.

post.summary: Apply to a vacancy
post.description: The vacancy must currently be OPEN, and a candidate can only apply once per vacancy — either condition failing is rejected rather than silently accepted.

get.summary: List a candidate's own applications
get.description: Every application this candidate has submitted, newest first, each with its own vacancy and offer (if any).

patch.description: Only a SENT offer can be responded to; a declineReason is stored only when accepted is false.

get.summary: List interviews with a failed calendar sync
get.description: Backs the "needs attention" widget — a plain filter on calendarSyncFailedAt, not a separate aggregation table. entityId is optional; omitted gives the cross-entity total.

get.summary: List interviews with a failed Teams meeting sync
get.description: Same shape as the calendar-sync failures list above, for the separate teamsSyncFailedAt flag.

post.summary: Schedule an interview
post.description: Moves the application into the INTERVIEW stage if it was APPLIED/SCREENING/SHORTLISTED. Then, best-effort and never blocking the create: syncs a Microsoft Graph calendar event, and — only when location is exactly "video-call" — creates a Teams meeting. Either sync failing just leaves the interview without that link; it does not fail this call.

get.summary: Get an interview
get.description: Includes its interviewers (with employee), its own feedback, and the job application (with candidate).

get.summary: List every interview for a job application
get.description: Ordered by scheduled time, earliest first.

get.summary: List an interviewer's upcoming interviews
get.description: SCHEDULED interviews only — rescheduled, cancelled, or completed ones are excluded.

patch.description: Sets status to RESCHEDULED. If a calendar event already exists, best-effort updates it too — a failure here does not fail the reschedule itself, it just marks the sync as failed for later retry.

Sets status to CANCELLED. If a calendar event and/or a Teams meeting exist, best-effort cancels each independently — either failing does not fail the cancel itself, it just marks that particular sync as failed for later retry.

post.summary: Manually retry a failed calendar sync
post.description: Two shapes depending on how it failed: no calendarEventId yet re-runs the original create; one already existing retries whichever call last failed (a cancel if the interview is now CANCELLED, otherwise an update). Unlike the best-effort sync during schedule/reschedule/cancel, a repeat failure here IS surfaced as a 409 — there is no primary write left to protect.

post.summary: Manually retry a failed Teams meeting sync
post.description: Same two-shape retry as the calendar-sync retry above, but narrower: no updateMeeting exists for Teams, so there is no "retry an update" case — only "the create never happened" or "a later cancel failed". A repeat failure is surfaced as a 409, same reasoning as the calendar retry.

patch.description: A manual alternative to the automatic completion submitFeedback triggers once every panelist has submitted their feedback.

patch.summary: Mark a candidate as a no-show for this interview

post.summary: Submit interviewer feedback for an interview
post.description: Only an assigned panelist can submit, and only once per panelist (409 on a second attempt). Rating must be 1-5. Once every panelist assigned has submitted, the interview is automatically marked COMPLETED as a side effect of this call.

get.summary: List every feedback submitted for an interview
get.description: One row per panelist who has submitted so far, each including its own employee record.

get.summary: Get the average interview rating for a job application
get.description: Averaged across every feedback row submitted for any of the application's interviews (rounded to 2 decimal places); null if no feedback has been submitted yet. Used for candidate scoring.

get.summary: Get each panelist's current Microsoft Graph presence
get.description: Lets a recruiter see who is currently online before deciding whether to reschedule around a likely-unavailable interviewer. Resolved by each panelist's own workEmail. Best-effort per panelist — one panelist's lookup failing (missing grant, no workEmail on file, throttling) never fails the whole call; that panelist is returned with presence: null and a presenceError instead of being dropped from the list.

get.summary: List offers with a failed signature sync
get.description: Every offer whose last e-signature send attempt failed (signatureSyncFailedAt is set), newest failure first — the source list behind the recruitment "needs attention" widget.

post.summary: Create a draft offer
post.description: At most one offer per application — a second call for the same jobApplicationId is rejected. proposedSalary must be positive. Defaults to the DocuSign provider if signatureProviderCode is omitted.

get.summary: Get an offer
get.description: Includes the offer's own application, candidate, and vacancy.

post.summary: Submit a draft offer for approval
post.description: Only a DRAFT offer can be submitted. Starts a RECRUITMENT_OFFER workflow instance (e.g. compensation-band approval) and moves the offer to PENDING_APPROVAL.

post.summary: Reconcile an offer with its own workflow instance
post.description: Call after acting on the linked workflow instance. Moves the offer to APPROVED or WITHDRAWN depending on the instance's own outcome; a no-op if the instance is still pending or the offer has no linked instance at all.

post.summary: Send an approved offer to the candidate
post.description: Only an APPROVED offer can be sent. Generates the offer letter, marks the offer SENT, and attempts an e-signature send (best-effort — a signature-provider failure never loses the already-persisted offer state).

post.summary: Retry a failed signature send
post.description: Only valid when the offer has a recorded signature-sync failure and no existing envelope — an offer that already has an envelope has no update/void retry path yet and is rejected instead.

post.summary: Reconcile an offer's signature status with the provider
post.description: Only meaningful for a SENT offer with an outstanding envelope; queries the provider directly and, if the envelope is now COMPLETED or DECLINED, records the response the same way the candidate portal's own respond endpoint would.

post.summary: Withdraw an offer
post.description: Sets the offer to WITHDRAWN regardless of its current status, and best-effort voids any outstanding signature envelope (a void failure is logged, not thrown — the withdrawal itself always succeeds).

post.summary: Start a background check for an application
post.description: Creates one IN_PROGRESS background check for the given jobApplicationId — at most one per application; a second call for the same application is rejected with a conflict rather than starting a duplicate. CandidateService.hire() later gates on this check's own status, so starting one is a prerequisite for hiring, not an optional record.

patch.description: Sets the check to CLEARED or FLAGGED depending on cleared, stamps completedAt, and stores the optional notes. There is no way to move a completed check back to IN_PROGRESS — this is a one-way transition.

get.summary: Get an application's background check
get.description: Returns the single background check for the given jobApplicationId, or null if none has been started yet.

post.summary: Create a budget shell with its lines
post.description: Starts DRAFT (schema default) regardless of any status implied elsewhere in the request.

get.summary: List budgets
get.description: entityId, fiscalYear, and status are all optional filters; RLS-scoped to the caller regardless.

get.summary: Get a budget by id, with its lines
Get budget-vs-actual variance by line
get.description: Actual figures are broken down by every dimension a line carries (account, project, phase, department, cost center, funding source).

post.summary: Submit a draft budget for approval
post.description: Only valid from DRAFT or REJECTED.

post.summary: Approve a submitted budget
Reject a submitted budget
post.description: Returns it to REJECTED — resubmittable via the same submit endpoint above.

post.summary: Close a budget at year end
post.description: Only valid from APPROVED. Terminal — no route reopens a closed budget.

post.summary: Revise line amounts on an approved budget
post.description: Only valid from APPROVED. Every referenced budgetLineId must already belong to this budget, or the whole request is rejected before any line is changed.

post.summary: Transfer an amount between two lines of the same approved budget

get.summary: List corrective actions

Reject a purchase order

post.description: The PO must currently be APPROVED or PARTIALLY_RECEIVED. Feeds the GR/IR clearing account that a later three-way match completion clears against.

post.description: purchaseOrderId is optional; when given, the PO must belong to the same entity/vendor as the invoice. A PO-backed invoice is expected to post through three-way match (POST /procurement/three-way-match/:id/complete) rather than directly through Accounts Payable.

post.description: Compares invoiced quantity/value against received quantity/value and marks the match MATCHED or MATCHED_WITH_VARIANCE depending on whether both are within tolerance. Does not itself post anything to AP — see POST /procurement/three-way-match/:id/complete for that.

post.description: Debits the GR/IR clearing account the matched GRN accrued to and credits the AP control account. post.summary: Import a bank statement
post.description: Rejected if the bank account does not exist or is inactive. Creates the statement together with all of its lines in one call.

get.summary: Get an imported bank statement with its lines

post.summary: Open a reconciliation session for an imported statement
post.description: Starts in DRAFT status. Rejected if the statement does not belong to the given entity/bank account.

get.summary: Get a reconciliation session
Get a session's reconciliation summary
get.description: Two-sided: statement lines not yet matched, AND posted journal lines on the bank GL account (within the statement period) not yet matched to any statement line — the book side of the reconciliation gap, not just the bank side.

post.summary: Auto-match unmatched statement lines against posted journal lines
post.description: Matches each unmatched statement line to an available posted journal line on the session's bank GL account, by amount (within 0.01) and transaction/entry date (within 5 days), using debit for a deposit / credit for a withdrawal. Each journal line can satisfy at most one match. Returns the count matched and remaining unmatched — does not throw if some lines find no match.

post.summary: Manually match one statement line to one journal line
post.description: Rejected if the session is not DRAFT, the statement line does not belong to this session, or the statement line is already matched.

post.summary: Record a book adjustment for an unmatched statement line
post.description: Used for bank-side-only items with no corresponding journal line (e.g. bank charges, interest income) rather than matching. INTEREST_INCOME is only valid against a deposit (positive) line; BANK_CHARGE is only valid against a withdrawal (negative) line — rejected otherwise.

post.summary: Approve a reconciliation session
post.description: Rejected if any statement line is still unmatched (every line must be matched or adjusted first), or if the caller is the same user who created the session.

get.description: A period flow, not a cumulative balance, for one entity and one fiscal period. Pass comparativeFiscalPeriodId for a prior-period comparative column alongside the current figures.

get.summary: IFRS Statement of Financial Position (balance sheet)
get.description: A point-in-time snapshot as at the end of one fiscal period. Includes a `balances` integrity check (assets vs. liabilities + equity) — this repo has no year-end close journal sweeping REVENUE/EXPENSE into Retained Earnings, so `balances` correctly reads false mid-year until a closing entry is posted; the ledger is reported as it stands, not plugged. Pass comparativeFiscalPeriodId for a prior-period comparative column.

get.summary: IFRS Statement of Cash Flows
get.description: Supports both IAS 7 presentations via the optional method parameter: INDIRECT (default, reconciles net profit to net cash from operations) or DIRECT (reconstructs major operating cash receipt/payment lines). Both are built from the same period movements, so operatingActivities matches between them — confirmed by the response's own reconcilesToIndirect field when method=DIRECT, and reconcilesToLedger (opening + net change = closing) either way.

get.description: Reads vw_financial_ratios for one entity, optionally narrowed to one fiscal period (omitting it returns every period on record, ordered oldest first). get.summary: IFRS Statement of Comprehensive Income

Other equity-reserve movements are deliberately excluded — this repo cannot distinguish genuine OCI from a transaction with owners in that catch-all bucket. Pass comparativeFiscalPeriodId for a prior-period comparative column.

get.summary: IFRS Statement of Changes in Equity

post.description: Exchanges a one-time Mono Connect widget code for a persisted link. Rejected with a 409 if the underlying Mono account is already linked to a bank account. Display metadata (institution name, masked account number, currency) is fetched best-effort — a failure there does not lose the link that already succeeded.

get.summary: List Mono-linked accounts for a bank account
get.description: bankAccountId is required, not optional.

delete.description: Idempotent — revoking an already-revoked link returns it unchanged rather than erroring.

get.summary: Get the current balance for a Mono-linked account
get.description: A thin pass-through to the Mono provider. Rejected with a 409 if the link is not currently ACTIVE.

post.summary: Pull a Mono statement for a date range and import it as a bank statement
post.description: Rejected with a 409 if the link is not currently ACTIVE, or if Mono reports zero transactions for the range. openingBalance is derived (current balance minus this period's net change), not fetched — exact when toDate is "now," an approximation otherwise, since Mono has no balance-as-of-a-past-date endpoint.

post.summary: Validate a bank account number/code pair via the given (or default PAYSTACK) provider
post.description: Stateless and provider-agnostic -- deliberately separate from MonoLinkedAccountController, which is specifically about Mono Connect linking; this has no linked-account concept involved. Gated on bank_link.view, the same lightweight read-only permission the linked-accounts list already uses, rather than a new permission.

post.summary: Create a new commission plan
post.description: Starts ACTIVE. Exactly one of projectId/estateId/unitId/agentId must match `scope` (GLOBAL sets none).

get.summary: List commission plans, optionally filtered by entity/scope/status/agent/project/estate/unit/isReferral
Resolve the single best-matching ACTIVE plan for a target
get.description: Precedence: UNIT > PROJECT > ESTATE > AGENT > GLOBAL. Returns null if nothing matches. Read-only — computes nothing.

get.summary: Get a single commission plan by id

patch.description: Cannot change status, code, entityId, scope, or scope-target fields — those are immutable after create.

post.summary: Deactivate an active commission plan
post.description: Only valid from ACTIVE — rejected with a 409 otherwise. No reactivation path; create a new plan instead.

post.summary: Preview a commission calculation without persisting it
post.description: Runs the identical resolution/computation logic as POST / — same validation, same plan resolution — but writes nothing.

post.summary: Calculate and persist a commission for a SALE-scope agent assignment
post.description: Resolves the applicable CommissionPlan (UNIT > PROJECT > ESTATE > AGENT > GLOBAL), applies its rate/tier schedule to the chosen basis, deducts WHT if a tax code is supplied, and snapshots every number used. Rejected with a 409 if the assignment already has an active (CALCULATED) calculation.

get.summary: List commission calculations, optionally filtered by entity/agent/status
List commission calculations for a specific agent
List commission calculations for a specific sale allocation
Get a single commission calculation by id

post.summary: Cancel a CALCULATED commission calculation that was never acted on
post.description: Terminal. Valid from CALCULATED or PENDING only — once APPROVED, use reverse instead. Recalculate (or use adjust) instead of trying to resurrect a cancelled row.

post.summary: Reverse a commission calculation (e.g. the underlying sale was reversed, or the calculation itself was wrong)
post.description: Terminal. Valid from any non-terminal status, including PAID (a clawback). The row is kept for audit, never deleted.

post.summary: Submit a CALCULATED commission for approval
post.description: CALCULATED -> PENDING. First step of the approval workflow — see CommissionCalculationService for the full transition graph.

post.summary: Approve a PENDING commission calculation
post.description: PENDING -> APPROVED. Requires commission.approve specifically, a distinct permission from commission.manage — a real maker-checker control.

post.summary: Reject a PENDING commission calculation
post.description: PENDING -> REJECTED. Terminal — a distinct outcome from cancel: this means an approver reviewed and declined it. Requires commission.approve, same as approve itself.

post.summary: Mark an APPROVED commission calculation as payable and post the accrual
post.description: APPROVED -> PAYABLE. Posts Dr commission expense (gross) / Cr WHT authority (if applicable) / Cr commission payable (net) through PostingEngineService.

post.summary: Mark a PAYABLE commission calculation as paid and post the clearing entry
post.description: PAYABLE -> PAID. Posts Dr commission payable (the same account markPayable recorded) / Cr cash through PostingEngineService.

post.summary: Reverse a commission calculation and immediately recalculate a corrected replacement, atomically
post.description: Valid from any non-terminal status. The new row is linked back to the one it replaced via supersedesCalculationId.

get.summary: Commission earned/approved/payable/paid/outstanding totals, optionally filtered by entity
Commission earned/paid/outstanding broken down by agent
Commission earned/paid/outstanding broken down by project, with a per-unit breakdown nested under each project
Commission aging — PAYABLE calculations bucketed by days outstanding since markedPayableAt
Commission forecast — unpaid pipeline grouped by lifecycle stage (CALCULATED/PENDING/APPROVED/PAYABLE)
A single agent statement: summary totals plus the full list of that agent's commission calculations

put.summary: Create or update one entity's company profile
put.description: Upserts EntityProfile by entityId. Returns 404 if the entity itself does not exist — no profile is created for an unknown entity.

get.summary: Get one entity's company profile
get.description: Returns null (not a 404) if no profile has ever been set for this entity — a missing profile is a valid, unconfigured state, not an error.

put.summary: Create or update one entity's branding/theme/locale profile
put.description: Upserts EntityBrandingProfile (colors, theme mode, white-label flag, language/timezone/number-format defaults) by entityId. Returns 404 if the entity itself does not exist.

get.summary: Get one entity's branding/theme/locale profile
get.description: Returns a real, documented set of default values (navy/gold theme, English, Africa/Lagos timezone) rather than null or a 404 when no profile has been configured yet, so callers never need to special-case an unconfigured entity.

get.summary: Effective branding for the current user at one entity
get.description: Merges the entity's own branding profile (or its built-in defaults) with the calling user's own personal theme/language/timezone overrides from their UserPreference, if any — the personal overrides win field by field where set.

post.summary: Upload one brand asset (logo, letterhead, watermark, stamp, signature)
post.description: multipart/form-data file upload, stored via the configured storage provider under a per-entity/per-asset-type key. If isDefault is set, any existing default asset of the same (entity, assetType) pair is demoted first — at most one default per entity/type at a time.

get.summary: List one entity's brand assets
get.description: Optionally narrowed to one assetType (e.g. LOGO); omitting it returns every asset type, newest first.

delete.description: Deletes the file from the storage provider first, then the database record — a real, ordered two-step delete, not a soft delete. Returns 404 if the asset does not exist.

post.summary: Create or update one document template
post.description: Upserts by the (entityId, templateType, code) triple. entityId is required and must reference a real entity — DocumentTemplate has no system-wide default.

get.summary: List document templates
get.description: Optionally narrowed by entityId and/or templateType; only active templates are returned, newest first.

get.summary: Resolve and render one document template
get.description: Resolves the entity-specific template for the given templateType/code; returns 404 if none exists. Any query parameter other than entityId/templateType/code is treated as merge-tag data and substituted into {{key}} placeholders in the template's subject/content.

put.summary: Create or update the current user's own personal preferences
put.description: Upserts UserPreference (theme/language/timezone overrides) for the calling user only — always acts on the authenticated user's own id, never a supplied one. Self-service: no permission beyond being authenticated is required, matching every other */me endpoint in this app.

get.summary: Get the current user's own personal preferences
get.description: Returns null if the calling user has never set any personal overrides — a real, valid "using entity defaults" state, not an error. Self-service: no permission beyond being authenticated is required, matching every other */me endpoint in this app.

post.summary: Create or update one translation entry
post.description: Upserts by the (locale, namespace, key) triple in this app's minimal i18n store — a single key's value is replaced in place, nothing else in the namespace is touched.

get.summary: Get all translation entries for one locale
get.description: Optionally narrowed to one namespace; omitting it returns every namespace for the locale. Returned as a flat { "namespace.key": value } map, not the underlying per-row shape.

get.summary: Liveness probe
get.description: Confirms the process is up and able to respond. Does not check dependencies (database, Redis) — see GET /ready for that.

get.summary: Readiness probe
get.description: Checks that the database and Redis are both reachable. Returns 503 if either check fails — use this to gate whether the process should receive traffic.

get.summary: Combined health summary
get.description: Same database/Redis checks as GET /ready, but always returns 200 (with a healthy/degraded status field) rather than a 503 — intended for dashboards and alerting rather than as a traffic gate.

get.summary: List every feature flag
get.description: Idempotently seeds every known default flag on each call, so a flag never listed elsewhere in @7f/config will still appear here even before the worker's own ensureDefaults() has run.

put.summary: Create or update a feature flag
put.description: A single endpoint handles both create and update (upsert on key) — there is no separate create-only route.

get.summary: List every role
get.description: Includes each role's permission count and assigned-user count, but not the permissions/users themselves — see GET /roles/:id for a role's full permission set.

post.summary: Create a new custom role
post.description: Always created with zero permissions and isSystem: false — this endpoint can never create or masquerade as one of the seeded system roles. Assign permissions afterward via PUT /roles/:id/permissions.

get.summary: Get one role, including its full permission set

put.summary: Replace a role's entire permission set
put.description: Full-replace, not incremental: deletes every existing permission assignment for this role and creates exactly the given set in one transaction. Rejects with 404 if any permissionCode is unrecognized, before making any change.

get.summary: List the entire permission catalog
get.description: The full, code-defined set of assignable permissions (module + code), not scoped to any one role.

get.summary: List every user
get.description: Deliberately excludes passwordHash/mfaSecret via an explicit field select, not an include — those never leave this endpoint even as new columns are added to User.

get.summary: Get one user, including their assigned roles

put.summary: Replace a user's entire set of role assignments
put.description: Full-replace, not incremental: deletes every existing role assignment for this user and creates exactly the given set in one transaction. Rejects with 404 if any roleId is unrecognized, before making any change.

get.summary: Prometheus-format metrics scrape endpoint
get.description: Plain-text exposition format, not JSON -- intended for a Prometheus scraper, not a human caller via this Swagger UI. No auth: same class of infrastructure endpoint as a health check.

post.summary: Send an SMS message
post.description: Asynchronous — enqueues the message onto the worker queue and returns immediately (queued: true); this does not wait for the provider to actually deliver it.

post.summary: Send a WhatsApp message
post.description: Asynchronous — enqueues the message onto the worker queue and returns immediately (queued: true); this does not wait for the provider to actually deliver it.

post.summary: Create a bank transfer record
post.description: Idempotent on reference: a repeat call with a reference that already exists returns that same record unchanged rather than erroring. Does not itself contact any bank — call initiate separately to actually send it.

get.summary: List bank transfers
get.description: RLS-scoped by entity. Optionally filtered by entityId/status/providerCode.

post.summary: Initiate a pending transfer with its provider
post.description: Idempotent: a record already past PENDING, or one that already has a providerTransferId, is returned as-is rather than calling the provider again — a duplicate call here could mean a duplicate real-world bank transfer. On provider failure, persists FAILED + the failure reason, then re-throws — the caller always knows it failed, never a silent 200 with a status they might not check.

post.summary: Re-check a transfer's current status with its provider
post.description: Callable regardless of current status, not just PENDING — re-verifying an already-SUCCESSFUL record is a legitimate reconciliation call. Deliberately asymmetric with initiate: a failure HERE means the status check itself failed (network/provider outage), not that the transfer failed, so the record's last-known status is left untouched rather than marked FAILED.

get.summary: Get a bank transfer by id
Get a bank transfer by its own reference
get.description: The same reference createRecord is idempotent on.

post.summary: Publish a new Power BI dataset
post.description: The caller supplies the full table schema (names, columns, and each column's own data type) — this route has no default schema of its own.

post.summary: Push rows into an existing dataset table
post.description: Rows are plain, caller-supplied objects — no schema validation against the table's own published columns happens at this layer.

post.summary: Trigger a dataset refresh

get.summary: Get a dataset's current/last refresh status
Get embed configuration for a Power BI report
get.description: Returns whatever the registered provider needs the frontend to embed the report client-side (typically an embed URL and a short-lived token) — the exact shape is provider-specific, not fixed by this route.

post.summary: Generate a new partner API key for an entity
post.description: The raw key is only ever returned in this response, once -- only its hash and a short display prefix are stored; it cannot be retrieved again after this call.

get.summary: List API keys, optionally filtered by entity
get.description: Never returns keyHash, even though it is a one-way hash -- general 'do not expose internal secrets' hygiene.

post.summary: Revoke an API key
post.description: Rejected with a 409 if the key is already revoked -- not a silent no-op.

post.summary: Create a new agent
post.description: Starts in PENDING_APPROVAL — see the approve endpoint to activate it.

get.summary: List agents, optionally filtered by entity/status/type or searched by name/code/email/phone
Get a single agent by id

patch.description: Cannot change status, code, or entityId through this endpoint — use the lifecycle endpoints below for status.

post.summary: Approve a pending agent
post.description: Only valid from PENDING_APPROVAL — rejected with a 409 otherwise.

post.summary: Suspend an active agent
post.description: Only valid from ACTIVE — rejected with a 409 otherwise.

post.summary: Reactivate a suspended agent
post.description: Only valid from SUSPENDED — rejected with a 409 otherwise.

post.summary: Terminate an agent
post.description: Valid from any non-terminal status. Terminal — a terminated agent cannot be un-terminated.

post.summary: Assign an agent to a project, unit, or confirmed sale
post.description: Exactly one of projectId/unitId/allocationId must be supplied, matching `scope`. At most one active PRIMARY assignment is allowed per target — a second is rejected with a 409, requiring the existing one to be ended first. entityId is cross-validated against the target's own real entity and rejected with a 400 on mismatch.

get.summary: Full assignment history for one agent
get.description: Includes ended assignments, not just active ones — this is the agent's own assignment history, most recent first.

get.summary: Full assignment history for one project, unit, or sale
get.description: Pass `scope` plus exactly one of projectId/unitId/allocationId. Includes ended assignments, most recent first.

get.summary: Get a single agent assignment by id

post.summary: End an active agent assignment
post.description: Preserved as history, never deleted. Rejected with a 409 if this assignment has already ended.

get.summary: Verify an API key works
get.description: No scope required by design -- lets a partner confirm a freshly-issued key is valid (right host, right header, not expired/revoked) before requesting any real scope be granted to it.

get.summary: Get the status of a bank transfer by reference (partner-facing, narrow shape)
get.description: Deliberately narrower than the internal record -- recipientAccountNumber/recipientBankCode/recipientName are never included, since this API-key-authenticated route has no RLS scoping the way an internal JWT-authenticated caller's request does.

get.summary: Get the status of a payment transaction by reference (partner-facing, narrow shape)
get.description: Same narrow-shape reasoning as transfer status -- no customerEmail, description, metadata, authorizationUrl, providerReference, or rawVerification.

get.summary: Get the status of a refund by reference (partner-facing, narrow shape)
get.description: Same narrow-shape reasoning again -- no rawResponse, no createdById.

get.summary: List the partner API versions this deployment currently supports
get.description: No API key required -- a partner without one yet still needs to know what to build against. Lives outside PartnerApiController's own versioned prefix so this route itself can never be versioned away.

get.summary: Global search across customers, vendors, employees, projects, and GL accounts
get.description: Self-service — each category is silently omitted when the caller lacks that category's own view permission (ar.view/ap.view/hr.view/pmo.view/coa.view). entityId scopes the employee/project categories only (customer/vendor/account are global master data with no entityId column).
